Class ServerLogger

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.is25am28.Network.Server.ServerLogger
public class ServerLogger extends Object
The ServerLogger class provides utility methods for logging messages to the console with various log levels (INFO, DEBUG, WARN, ERROR). This class supports both generic logging and logging specific to a game instance by accepting an optional game ID.

    • info

      public static void info(String tag, String gameId, String message)
      Logs an informational message to the console with a specific tag and game ID.
      Parameters:
      tag - a descriptive label used to categorize or identify the source of the log message
      gameId - the identifier of the associated game instance; may be null if the message is not game-specific
      message - the content of the log message to be displayed
